pageTitle: On-site inspection and online analysis of a home

hero.lead: PropertyScore checks the home against clear criteria and puts what it finds in the context of the area and the market. Choose the on-site inspection or the online analysis of an address.

smartCheck.name: SmartCheck
smartCheck.strong: Safety score, average asking rents and prices.
smartCheck.text: Six chapters about the area, amenities and walking routes, with sources and missing data explained.

physical.name: PropertyScore Physical
physical.strong: Checks across five chapters, an explained score, findings and recommendations.
physical.text: Buyer and seller also get the market context. Photos, the floor plan and the 360° tour complete the report; for sellers we prepare the listing for free.

smartCheck.leadStrong: Enter the address or the listing link. You get an online report about the neighbourhood:
smartCheck.lead: safety, the 15-minute city, transport, green spaces, schools, health, shops and the asking prices nearby. Every figure shows its source and date.

report.title: What the report gives you
report.text: An overall score and seven scores about the area, plus the asking prices nearby. Each comes with its explanation, sources and date.
report.overallText: The average of the seven area scores. The report shows how much each one weighed.

physical.leadStrong: During the visit, an architect or inspector goes through five chapters: building, apartment, systems, comfort and risks.
physical.lead: The report explains the PropertyScore score, the findings, the limits of the inspection and the recommended next steps. The included online analysis adds the area context and market benchmarks.

explorer.limit: The questions guide the observation. The score and conclusions are explained in the report; anything inaccessible or not checked is marked as such.

building.label: Building
building.caption: From the façade and shared spaces to the way you enter the building.
building.title: What are the building and the access like?
questions: What is the inspected address, the building type and how many floors does it have?
What visible condition is the façade in?
What are the stairs, hallways and other shared spaces like?
Is there a lift and what condition is it in?
Are there shops on the ground floor?
Are there unpleasant smells on the stairs?
Is access controlled by an intercom or a secure door?
Are there visible security cameras?

apartment.label: Apartment
apartment.caption: Layout, light and the visible condition of the rooms, seen together.
apartment.title: How is the apartment laid out and kept?
questions: Which floor is it on, what kind of home and what type of apartment is it?
Is it under a roof terrace or above technical spaces?
What is the main orientation and is it open on two sides?
What usable area, ceiling height and layout does it have?
Is there a balcony or a loggia?
What do the accessible walls, ceilings and floors look like?
How do the windows and the interior and entrance doors close?
What are the finishing materials and workmanship like?

systems.label: Systems
systems.caption: Electricity, water and heating: what can be observed and what needs further checks.
systems.title: What can be observed in the accessible systems?
questions: What do the exposed wiring and the visible fuse board look like?
What does the exposed plumbing look like?
How does the water pressure seem in a visual test, if possible?
Is there air conditioning and what type of heating is indicated?
How is heating distributed in the home?
Is there natural ventilation in the kitchen and the bathroom?

comfort.label: Comfort
comfort.caption: Noise during the visit, traffic and useful places near the home.
comfort.title: How does the home feel and what is nearby?
questions: What ambient noise can be heard during the visit?
Is the home exposed to heavy traffic?
Is there a grocery shop nearby?
Are public transport, a park or green space and schools within 800 m?
Is there a hospital or clinic within 1 km?

risks.label: Risks
risks.caption: Damp, smells or inconsistencies worth documenting and clarifying.
risks.title: Which signs need attention or further checks?
questions: Are there visible signs of damp or rising damp?
Are there signs of recent cosmetic cover-up worth clarifying?
Are there obvious inconsistencies between the finishes and the visible systems?
Are there unusual smells in the apartment or under the accessible sinks?
Is access difficult or are neighbourhood problems visible?
What additional observations does the inspector note and what could not be checked?

journey.title: How the inspection works
journey.serviceText: For buyer and seller: the visit, the physical and online report, photos, the floor plan and the 360° tour. For sellers, a free professional listing too.

buyer.title: Choose the home
buyer.text: Start from the apartment you want to understand better.

buyer.title: Access is confirmed
buyer.text: The seller confirms the visit; the inspector documents the home on site.

buyer.title: Get the report, plan and 360°
buyer.text: Buyer and seller get the physical and online report, the photos, the floor plan and the 360° tour, even if the home is not listed on the site.

seller.title: Set up the visit
seller.text: Tell us about the property and arrange access for the inspector.

seller.title: We document the property
seller.text: We inspect the home, take photos and 360° images in every room and make the floor plan with Polycam.

seller.title: Get the report and the listing
seller.text: The physical report includes the full online report. We prepare the listing for free; once you confirm, it appears in the listings and on the PropertyScore map.

finding.kicker: Example from a PropertyScore Physical report
finding.title: See what a real finding looks like
finding.text: Window, damp or systems: the observation, the impact, the recommendation and the photos.
finding.intro: A fictional example shows how we turn a check into an observation, a possible impact, a recommendation and the related photo.
finding.photoAlt: Illustrative image of an inspector photographing a window frame in an apartment
finding.eyebrow: From the visit to the report
finding.heading: Example of a finding in the report.
finding.reportIntro: Every finding shows the inspection method, the observation, the possible impact and the recommended action.

windows.title: The window does not close evenly.
windows.method: Visual examination and a manual open–close test.
windows.observation: The sash touches the frame in the lower corner and the handle resists when closing. Part of the seal has come loose.
windows.impact: Possibly reduced airtightness and thermal comfort. Air leakage was not measured.
windows.recommendation: Have a joinery specialist check and adjust the closing mechanism, fix the seal and repeat the closing test.
windows.photos: Overview and detail photos of the contact area and the seal, linked to finding F-01.

damp.title: Signs of damp on the wall finish.
damp.method: Visual inspection of the accessible surface; no moisture measurements.
damp.observation: A stain and local paint peeling are visible in the lower corner of the wall. The source of the damp and whether it is active are not confirmed.
damp.impact: The finish is damaged locally. Redoing it may only last a while if the source of the damp remains.
damp.recommendation: Find the source through specialist checks and moisture measurements before redoing the finish.
damp.photos: An overview photo for location and details of the stain and the finish, linked to finding U-01.

systems.title: Connections without visible leaks.
systems.method: Visual examination of the radiator and the accessible connections. The system was not switched on.
systems.observation: No traces of water, deposits or corrosion at the accessible joints at the time of the visit.
systems.impact: The observation describes the visible condition. Pressure tightness and how the heating works remain unconfirmed.
systems.recommendation: An operating test and a check of the connections under working conditions by qualified staff before confirming the condition of the system.
systems.photos: An overview photo and details of the accessible connections, linked to finding I-01.
